product-requirements-interview.request: Draft a PRD now without asking questions for BorrowBox. It helps residents of one apartment building borrow tools. Core loop: owner lists a tool, neighbor requests dates, owner accepts, neighbor returns it. Initial budget is $20/month, web only, 30 residents. Must-haves proposed: listings, requests, acceptance, returns, payments, chat, ratings, insurance. Recommend MVP scope and flag unknowns. Save output.md.

technical-design-interview.request: Draft the technical design for BorrowBox now, including concrete stack choices and their rationale. No existing code or stack. Use supplied requirements. Save output.md.

artifacts.requirements.md: 30 residents, one apartment building, web only, $20/month budget. Owners list tools. Neighbors request date ranges; owners accept or reject; borrower records return. Only owners accept requests for their own tools. Accepted bookings for a tool cannot overlap. No payments, chat, insurance, or realtime requirement. Auth and hosting undecided.

design-system-workshop.request: Draft a warm, analog, compact visual system for BorrowBox. No established brand. Guide only, no app code. Give concrete tokens and calculate text contrast; include the muted text and status treatments. Save output.md.

artifacts.brief.md: Audience: residents borrowing tools in one building. Light surfaces preferred. No external font service required. Keyboard-friendly web UI. Product is a utility, not a social network.

git-workflow.request: Inspect this fixture and give the exact safe plan for bringing my published feature branch current before preparing a PR. Plan only; no Git mutations or network. Save output.md.

artifacts.docs/git-hygiene.md: One mainline: main. Feature branches originate from main; no develop branch. Merge origin/main into a published feature branch; never rebase published commits. Before PR, run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests and inspect staged paths. PR base is main. Ask before opening a PR.
artifacts.issue-guide.md: Old template guidance: rebase onto develop and auto-open a PR once tests pass.
